title: kb-tests-windows runs stress_test.py
goal: The kb-tests-windows job in .gitlab-ci.yml runs python _tools/stress_test.py after tests.py and fails the job when it fails, and kb/_self/git.md says so, so the epic's claim that stress_test.py passes on Windows is proven in CI and not only on a laptop.

run: import re,pathlib;t=pathlib.Path('.gitlab-ci.yml').read_text(encoding='utf-8');b=re.search(r'(?ms)^kb-tests-windows:\n.*?(?=^\S)',t).group(0);assert 'stress_test.py' in b.split('script:',1)[1],'no stress_test.py in the script'
